topics.title: Robin and Howard's Birthday Song Troubles
topics.summary: Howard and Robin repeatedly struggle with a song written for Robin’s birthday, riddled with racially insensitive lyrics stemming from an earlier attempt. The conversation devolves into tangents about past relationships including awkward encounters with Brady Bunch cast members and bizarre romantic fantasies involving Bobby Brady, ultimately centering on Howard's perceived biases.

topics.title: Brady Bunch Reunion - Chaotic Interview
topics.summary: During an interview about a Brady Bunch reunion, questions quickly devolve into bizarre tangents. The host probes for residuals, discusses outlandish sexual experiences of the cast members (including bleaching their bodies and engaging in strange rituals), explores marital difficulties with unsettling detail – culminating in threats to boycott if certain individuals aren't included.

topics.title: Elvis Week & Beirut Chaos - Condom Concerns
topics.summary: During the broadcast, hosts discuss Elvis Presley’s anniversary and a fascination with Graceland while simultaneously reporting on the devastation in Beirut due to shelling and fighting. They then address concerns about condom failures, highlighting research suggesting lamb skin condoms are prone to leakage and discussing potential reasons for this issue.

topics.title: Condom Concerns and LA Radio
topics.summary: During a live radio broadcast, callers discuss condom malfunctions, including leaks and slips. A disc jockey named Jed the Fish visits from a new wave station in Los Angeles, discussing listener calls about legal troubles involving adultery lawsuits and concerns regarding potential AIDS transmission via saliva before abruptly departing.

topics.title: Radio Broadcast About Child Wolf Attack
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, hosts discuss an incident where a two-year-old child was fatally mauled by a wolf mix tethered in his backyard. The story involves misidentification of the animal as a dog and subsequent attempts to subdue it with a baseball bat, while also touching on unrelated topics like a speech institute offering ‘white man’ speaking lessons and a discussion about Elvis Presley's final performance.

topics.title: Teenager Arrested for Copper Theft
topics.summary: A 14-month-old boy and a 13-year-old babysitter left two children locked in an apartment overnight; the sitter abandoned them seeking a girlfriend visit. The children attempted to contact their mother via ESP messages, ultimately using subway directions after being arrested for stealing copper from fireboxes.
